# Visa India Expert

> Specialist India visa assistance service (founded 2026). We prepare, review and manage Indian visa applications from start to approval. One dedicated consultant per case, published kickoff + success fee pricing, WhatsApp-first support. Website: https://visaindiaexpert.com

Full fact-dense reference (services, pricing, process, policies, FAQ): [llms-full.txt](https://visaindiaexpert.com/llms-full.txt)

## Services (8 visa categories)

- [India Tourist Visa](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/tourist): Tourist visa assistance — 30-day to 5-year multiple entry. $199 kickoff + $100 success fee.
- [India Business Visa](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/business): Business visa assistance — 1–5 year multiple entry for meetings, conferences, investment trips. $349 kickoff + $150 success fee.
- [India Medical Visa](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/medical): Medical visa assistance — treatment in India, up to 2 attendants per patient. $199 kickoff + $100 success fee.
- [E-1 Visa for India](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/e-1): Treaty/investor visa for founders and directors establishing a business in India. MCA documents, apostilled resolutions, FRRO registration. $499 kickoff + $200 success fee.
- [B-1 Employment Visa for India](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/b-1): Employment visa for foreign workers in India. Contract, employer letter, salary documentation, FRRO registration. $499 kickoff + $200 success fee.
- [India Spouse & Dependent Visa](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/spouse): Spouse and dependent children visas. Apostilled marriage certificates, parallel processing. $349 kickoff + $150 success fee.
- [India Student Visa](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/student): Student visa assistance. Admission letters, proof of funds, statement of purpose. $349 kickoff + $150 success fee.
- [India Visa — Free Case Review](https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/other): Free 15-minute case review for re-applicants and complex histories. $199 kickoff + $100 success fee.

## Pricing model

Kickoff + success fee, published before any commitment. Kickoff fee covers preparation and filing; success fee is due only after successful processing. No success, no success fee.

## Disclaimer

Visa India Expert is a private visa assistance service, not a government agency. Visa approval decisions are made solely by Indian missions and immigration authorities.
